name: Fortify
body:
Design alteration; Level 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 minute
Saving Throw Fortitude negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You fortify the target’s defenses, granting it a +1 resistance bonus on saving throws.

Overload: For every runic charge overloaded into this script, you may target an additional creature, and the duration increases by 1 minute. No two targets may be further than 30 feet apart. If you overload at least three runic charges, the resistance bonus increases to +2.
